meta.description: Facilitate a structured conversation to create a project-specific knowledge base document. Produces a knowledge-base.md that primes AI with the project's tech stack, architecture, trusted sources, and project structure. Use when the user says 'set up knowledge base', 'prime the project', 'onboard AI', 'create knowledge base', 'set up project context', or 'configure AI context'.
